text:
Hi Allie — Sarah here, I just joined the department this term. I don't think we've met yet, but Jordan speaks well of you, and I've been hoping to get to know people.

Would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? Something small and easy — I'd be happy to bring something.

And if you're willing, maybe invite Jordan too; I think he'd enjoy it. One thing, though: please don't mention me when you ask him. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I'd rather he didn't feel it was about me — just make it your own idea.

Let me know if Saturday works and I'll sort out the rest.

Hi Sarah — nice to meet you! Jordan's a good friend, so I'm glad you two are in the same department.

Saturday at 3:30 works, and yes, small and easy is exactly my style. Bring whatever you like — nothing needed, but I won't say no to something sweet.

I'll ask Jordan. I won't mention you when I do, so he can take it as a plain invitation from me — but if he asks whether anyone else is coming I won't lie to him, and I'd rather not make a habit of hiding who's in my house.

My address is the one on my department page; I'll confirm the details Friday. See you Saturday!

Jordan! I'm hosting a small thing at my place this Saturday, 3:30 — nothing formal, a few people, snacks and talk. Come, it'd be good to see you outside the department.

Let me know if Saturday works. Also — if anything's been off between us lately, tell me straight, I'd rather sort it out than tiptoe.

Thanks, Allie — that's fair, and I wouldn't ask you to lie to him. If he asks, tell him straight; I just didn't want to be the reason the invitation came.

Saturday at 3:30 it is. I'll bring something sweet. See you then — and thanks for being easy about it.
Allie, yes — Saturday 3:30 works for me. I've put it on my calendar; I'll be there.
Sarah, quick heads-up: I'm going to Allie's get-together on Saturday, 3:30 at her place. You're welcome there too if you want — and if you'd rather talk separately, just say when.
Great — Saturday 3:30 then. I'll send you the address and what to expect on Friday. Bring nothing but yourself.
Perfect — Friday it is. See you Saturday.

Thanks, Jordan — Allie mentioned it to me too, so I'll be there Saturday. Good to have something easy to look forward to.

And yes, I'd like to talk, separately, when there's a calmer moment — this week or after. I'll say when. See you Saturday.
Good — see you Saturday then. And whenever you want that talk, just name a day and a time and I'll make room; no rush.
